verdict.rationale: Fenwick's executive compensation page confirms it structures and drafts employee equity plans and handles related tax issues (409A, 162(m), 280G), which covers the general option-plan design service, but there is no evidence on its pages of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOP, or other jurisdiction-specific schemes, and its offices list is US-only. missing for 10: explicit mention of UK EMI/German VSOP/Indian ESOP or other local equity scheme expertise, international office presence supporting such work.
